tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bar thab pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag bzhugs so// bar thab ja dpon gcig dang g.yog bzhi bcas nas do gal byed dgos/ gtso bo chos 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang byed kyang / lhag bsam rnam dag gi dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel zhing / rang la tshe 'dir mgo yod kyis 'jur thag tsha drag can dang gzhan gyi mi kha mi 'byung ba dang / phyi ma ngan song sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong mi dgos pa'i do dam rang sems dpang por bzhag pa'i rang gis rang gcur thub pa zhig rang gal che bas/ de ltar go bar byas ngos/ las bya rgyu'i rim par/ zhal ngo'i gras rje btsun ma dang / phyag gnyer gsol gzim sogs sku gzhogs pa tshang ma/ rgyun sgrogs gzhi grwa mgron gnyer gnyis/ gnyer tshang pa gnyis/ khang dpon 'ga' pa gnyis/ rtswa gnyer/ chibs dpon/ shing dpon/ 'dren pa/ rtse gad pa/ rje btsun ma dang / yum lcam gyi zla bo/ mi dpon bzhi/ rngod rgyab pa gnyis/ tshos dpon rnams las sku gzhog pa phar cher dang / mgron gnyer gnyis/ gnyer tshang pa gnyis/ 'gag pa gnyis/ rtse khang gnyer rnams gzhi thog nang khul dang / phun gling sgo spe sogs nye 'khor du shag 'dzin pas zhogs ja nas srod thung gi bar yang rdzogs/ khang dpon rtsa gnyer/ chibs dpon/ shing dpon/ 'dren pa rnams la zhogs ja skyogs do re/ de phyin drung skya rnams shag sna tshogs su 'dzin pas/ phyag gnyer gzhungs su tshang ma 'dzom thog ja gang 'gro dang / khang dpon shing gnyer gnyis rgyun du phyir 'gro mang ba dang / rtswa gnyer la'ang dbyar sogs skabs re phyir 'gro byed dgos dang / gzhan yang gzhung las la phyir 'gro byed dgos rnams la chad ja ma byung phyin de skabs ja gang song gi skal bar skyogs re re sgo dpon rgyal sgo dang khad nye 'brel mtshungs su snga thog bzhin bltar chags su sdod dgos pas ja skal skyogs bcu gsum dang thug pa gang sogs nas skyogs re re bcas dus gcig du len pa'am/

rim len gang bde byed/ mi dpon bzhi/ rngod rgyab pa gnyis/ tshos dpon rnams gnyer tshang du las 'gro'i skabs zhogs ja'i bskyar zhus nas/ gsol gong ma'i bskyar zhus yan/ dgong ja'i bskyar zhus rnams 'dren len gang 'os las/ gzhan rnams skal ba sprod mi dgos/ rgyun sgrogs bzhi gral snga thugs nas dgong ja'i bskyar zhus yan/ mkhan chen khri pa dang / zur bzhugs par nyin ltar skyogs bzhi re/ gro nag spu gsum gyis bla ma dang / dgu gzhung tshong dpon rkang ma rnams la zhogs/ rting dgong ja gsum gyi thob sdom skyogs drug re/ rgyun gtan zhal ja min pa'i rigs/ chos 'phrul dang mdos chen gyi thor ja rgyal sgo yan la sngar rgyun bzhin dmigs bsal byung na ma gtogs shar skya nas snga ba mi bskor/ gzhan bar ja 'phar rigs rnams bskor len gong 'khod bzhin/ g.yul thang mdun skor gson rgyag gang yod/ sgo ma'i blta bskor/ g.yul thang 'ong lan/ zhal ngo rnams dang / phyag gnyer gzhung du mgron ja gang dgos/ phyag gnyer gnyis la zhogs ja dang skabs gong 'os su ja tib re gsol gzim mchod gsum/ drung yig lde chung pa rnams la zhogs ja dod skor gyi steng / skyogs do re/ byings la zhogs ja dod skor re/ phyag gnyer gnyis la snga dgong thug phru re/ nged rang gi gsol gzim gnyis la thug phru re/ gzhan gzhi thog nang khul gyi drung ser skyar snga dgong bskor thug la/ snga dro gang dang dgong mo do re/ rgyal po lo gsar dmag dpon bzhugs gral/ gdung rgyud khri phebs skabs kyi ston mo'i rigs/ rab ston dbus bskor sogs/ zhal ngo phyogs 'grul 'gugs pa'i ston mo rnams kyi thog drangs skya ser sna tshogs 'dus pa'i bzhugs gral gyi ja rnams/ phyogs 'grul dang chu tshan rnams kyi skabs/ nged rang / rtse thab nas 'gro 'os rnams yod tshe thab khag gnyis dang / de min bar thab nas za ma 'gro khungs sngar rgyun bzhin/

'bras sil dang gro ma mar khu thug 'phar sogs gang dgos gong 'khod drung ser skya nas g.yos 'du'i dngos po rang rang gi lag thog nas bton phyin/ de rang la gang thon gyi bza' btung 'gad gtsang bar thab pa rnams kyis lag len nye 'gyangs med par byed/ zhal ngo dang phyag gnyer gyi me slang / de phyin gzhi thogs sogs pho brang nang khugs kyi shag thab 'dzin mi 'os pa'i/ ser skya rnams la me snod che chung lugs mthun la cha snyoms kyi thon tshe nyin ltar me slang gnyis re/ rang rang gis snga phyi gang dgos su len/ yang nges par thab me stobs che bar ma thon tshe/ me slang re'i rtsis gtong dgos rgyur/ sger g.yos dang me slang tshang ma rang rang gis skyel len las/ thab mi rnams mi 'gro/ de dag gi gnas skabs su/ gzhung sger gyi ja mar sha 'bras sogs dngos po gang la'ang brnab sems dang rkun ma rku ba sogs nyes pa thams cad spangs nas gtsang zhing g.yos legs bza' btung nyan nges kho na ma gtogs/ de ltar ma yin pa'i rjes ngan gleng brjod sna tshogs byung na/ de 'phral mgo yod kyis mtshon tshang mar phyi lam khegs pa'i chad pa gtong nges yin pas de bzhin mi yong ba'i bdag don bdag gces gal che zhing chu len skabs gtsang sbra dang / shing len khyi rdzas bcas sngar rgyun bzhin dang / chang rgyu'i mkhan sar nyin ltar ja skyogs bcu gnyis re 'dzin gzhung don dmigs bsal gyis 'phar dgos pa byung na ma gtogs/ gzhan tho 'di sor bzhag las/ rang mtshams kyi spar gcog sna tshogs byas pa byung na/ gsol dpon dang ja dpon nas brnyas bsko su yin de la tho 'di mig brdar dang / gang ci'i gse bkrol bya dgos shing / de la lta ba pos kyang tho don dang mi 'gal zhing gzhung slebs che ba zhig yin na 'di ltar yin gyi gsal drang po byed pa las g.yo sgyu zol zog kha 'jam sems stug gi rigs gtan nas mi byed/ thab 'dir las byed pa rnams dang /

za ma 'gro khung rnams nas yong dgos nges rnams ma gtogs gzhan mi yan gyi rigs mi gtong zhing / dor kyang dang zon pa gyon pa sogs bla ma gong ma'i pho brang la dma' 'bebs dang / nged rang gi drung du mgron po bsgrigs skabs mi mdzes pa'i kun spyod thams cad bsrung nas chen po'i gan du 'gro ba'i spyod lam kho na ma byung na/ gsol dpon nas de 'phral babs thob dang mthun pa'i chad pa 'gel lugs byed/ chu me shing sogs rang gi gdong gang gi las gang yin de la lto byin pa'i don yod pa zhig ja dpon nas bzung thams cad kyis nges 'tshal/ gong gsal gyi ja mar tsha 'bras tshang ma thog mar gtan 'bebs yang dag bgyis pa'i thog dngos chas ma nyung ma mang ba dkrigs sbyar yong bas thon gzhi 'degs shor byed// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ bar thab pa rnams nas bya dgos rnam gzhag/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
